The analysis_summary.jsonl file contains all scalar descriptors and image paths; this file is read first.  A brief literature query set is generated based on the descriptor types and the overarching research question, followed by PubMed searches to gather relevant references.  Finally, the `generate_html_report` tool is invoked, passing both the parsed analysis data and the curated literature list.  All intermediate artefacts (e.g., literature hits) are stored in memory; only the final report is written to the reporter directory as `report.html`.
